flavor.phonemic_palette: Hellenic backbone (a e i o u + long e/o; th/ph/kh; endings -os/-on/-es/-eus) with an Egyptian overlay (dj/tj touches, -aa/-et in the substrate, Per-/Niut- toponyms); theophoric on the Hellenic morphs (Tulrios-, Numenos-) with Egyptian variants.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Greek + Egyptian per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Greek + Egyptian register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'ptolan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Ptolan — cosmopolitan imperial bureaucracy of the desert; knowledge, wealth.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Ptolan (Greek + Egyptian) are a assertive imperial bureaucracy people seeded in desert, scrubland, coastal. They prize knowledge, wealth, tradition, lean toward the mercantile sphere, and field pikemen, war_elephants, marines. Outsiders are met as cosmopolitan; their patrons touch knowledge, trade, harvest.
